name: Sano Reina
source:
Haruno's friend since high school.

She supports her despite her harsh words and isn't afraid to speak her mind. When Haruno wants to say something but can't, she'll step in and talk for her.

[Translated from [url=http://dswtc.web.fc2.com/game/nekonare/nekonare.html]official website[/url]]
